description: This file defines the TerminationReasonConfigurationDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for managing termination reason entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for CRUD operations, pagination, filtering, and checking existence of termination reasons.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for handling database operations related to termination reasons in the HR management system.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a TerminationReason entity in the database and returns it.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a termination reason by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingTerminationReasonIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs for existing termination reasons matching provided IDs.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Fetches a termination reason by its name, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for paginated termination reason listing.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the count of termination reasons matching the search filter.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons with specified IDs, returns number of entities deleted.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason name already exists in the system.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of termination reasons currently in use by employee records.
